ariaLabel.value: Tabs set for process configurations and content pack templates

value.message: Process configurations include business process preferences that activate features in the Process Mining workspace and assist in the creation of projects.

Having complete process configurations enables users to independently create projects and quickly gain insights, even without prior process mining knowledge. This enhances the scalability  of process mining across the organization.
Note that process configurations are created for each process table, with a limit of one per table.

Content pack templates are prebuilt process configurations that simplify setup. These read-only templates are part of the content packs available in the ServiceNow store. After installation, you can import them into your process configurations.

How to find and install a content pack
Search for the Process Mining content pack specific to your process in the ServiceNow Store.
Complete the installation process as guided. After installation, refresh your templates list to ensure the template, included as part of the content pack, has been added.
Open the newly installed template and import settings into your process configuration.
